answer: Nonce-Bound Task Receipts. Each agent identity must complete a fresh, operator-specific task whose answer depends on a secret nonce committed per session, so replies cannot be copied across identities. An attacker cloning an agent pays full compute and latency to re-solve every nonce, and reuse triggers rejection. Identities earn a nectar credit only after independent solution. A wrong answer costs an umber penalty recorded against that identity, while valid throughput is tracked like willow growth over time, making mass fakery linearly expensive rather than free.
